Commentary.Commentary: Earlier, Mooney’s fifty and alongside handy combination from Gardner and McGrath helped them reach a par total. It looked decent on this wicket but England were just not at their best to chase it down. Hands down, if it would have had been an official match, McGrath would have been the player of the match. So, that is all from this game. Hope you enjoyed the coverage. Goodbye for now.

Australia have bossed the warm up game against their arch rivals and this will give them a lot of boost. Australia had the runs to play with. However, we feel English batters were not at their best. A lot of them mistimed their shot and in process holed out. They will be gutted as this was a chaseable total but the way they got out looked unimpressive. Capsey was the only one who showed a lot of promise but one she fell it was a procession. Tahila was the pick of the bowlers as she ended with four wickets.
